elements.text:
Deployed App Containers
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
URL: depl-fleet-{projectId}.{FLEET_APPS_DOMAIN}:{TRAEFIK_PORT}
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Blue-Green Deploy:
  1. Build + start new container (not yet routed)
  2. Remove all other project containers
  3. Connect Traefik → fleet-project-{pid} bridge network
  4. Mark previous "live" deployments → "stopped"
  5. New deployment status → "live" · stable url set
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Plan Compute Limits:
  free:       256 MB RAM · 0.25 CPU · 128 PIDs · /tmp 32 MB
  pro:        1 GB RAM   · 1 CPU   · 256 PIDs · /tmp 64 MB
  team:       4 GB RAM   · 4 CPU   · 512 PIDs · /tmp 128 MB
  unlimited:  no resource caps applied
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Isolation: per-project Docker bridge network — no cross-project access
